content.short: Parrot Protocol is a Solana-based non-custodial lending DeFi and liquidity network enabling access to the stablecoin PAI and value in LP tokens.
content.description: Parrot Protocol is a Solana-based, non-custodial lending DeFi and liquidity network. It enables users to access the stablecoin PAI and participate in a non-custodial lending market that allows value to be realized from LP tokens. The lending system is collateralized by LP tokens, supporting loans against liquidity provider positions. Developers can view statistics and metrics on the site to monitor activity, performance, and overall network health.
